definitions.rationale: This rule expands the named proof term solutionProgram into the translated constructor AST used by the verification claims.
definitions.text:
rule solutionProgram =>
    Module(
      FuncDef("correct_bracketing", Params("brackets"),
        Assign(Name("count"), Int(0))
        For(Name("bracket"), Name("brackets"),
          If(Compare(Name("bracket"), CmpOp("==", Str("("))),
            Assign(Name("count"),
              BinOp("+", Name("count"), Int(1))),
            If(Compare(Name("count"), CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
              Return(Bool(false)),
              .Stmts)
            Assign(Name("count"),
              BinOp("-", Name("count"), Int(1)))))
        Return(Compare(Name("count"), CmpOp("==", Int(0))))))

definitions.rationale: This is the base equation of the bracketSpec mathematical summary: an empty suffix is accepted exactly when the unmatched-opening count is zero.
This is the opening-bracket recurrence of bracketSpec, consuming one character and incrementing the unmatched-opening count.
definitions.text:
rule bracketSpec(N, S)
    => bracketSpec(N +Int 1, substrString(S, 1, lengthString(S)))
    requires notBool (S ==String "")
     andBool substrString(S, 0, 1) ==String "(" [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This is the zero-depth rejection clause of bracketSpec for a nonempty suffix whose first character is not an opening bracket.
definitions.text:
rule bracketSpec(0, S) => false
    requires notBool (S ==String "")
     andBool notBool (substrString(S, 0, 1) ==String "(") [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This is the positive-depth closing recurrence of bracketSpec, consuming one character and decrementing the unmatched-opening count.
definitions.text:
rule bracketSpec(N, S)
    => bracketSpec(N -Int 1, substrString(S, 1, lengthString(S)))
    requires notBool (S ==String "")
     andBool notBool (substrString(S, 0, 1) ==String "(")
     andBool N >Int 0 [simplification]
